description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the LDAPSyncService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the creation and updating of system users from LDAP data. It defines a test class with multiple test scenarios involving LDAP user synchronization, using mocks and fixtures.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP synchronization functionality in OrangeHRM, involving user creation, updates, and handling complex LDAP-user-related scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting fixture directory, mock DateTime helper, and kernel with mock services.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests creation of system users from LDAP data, asserting the number of users, providers, and employees after sync.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithLocalUsers
methods.description: Verifies LDAP sync creates additional users when local user data exists without LDAP providers.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithEmployeeMapping
methods.description: Checks correct updating of employee last names based on LDAP sync, with existing employees.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenUsernameChanged
methods.description: Ensures users are correctly updated when LDAP username attribute changes, replacing old user record.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsNotChanged
methods.description: Checks that no unnecessary updates occur when LDAP data matches existing user data.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsChanged
methods.description: Ensures employee records are updated correctly when LDAP attributes like 'workEmail' change.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithNonUniqueEmployeeIdAndWorkEmail
methods.description: Tests behavior when multiple employees have non-unique email addresses or IDs, ensuring correct user creation.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Helper method to create mock LDAPUser objects for testing, based on predefined user name list.
